description: List the Bitcoin Runes catalog: identity, supply, mints, and mint terms. Keyless on OSS loopback; otherwise needs INSTANCE_TOKEN (OSS) or SECONDLAYER_API_KEY (hosted). Self-host needs the bitcoin compose profile. `notes` says when Runes is not configured.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's next_cursor

search.description: Name prefix, spacers and case ignored (dog matches DOG•GO•TO•THE•MOON)

sort.description: number (etch order, default) or mints (busiest first)

name: index_runes
